parameters.name: Object Path
parameters.description: Select which geometry object to load. All Objects (*) loads everything.

parameters.name: Load Type
parameters.description: Immediate loads on current frame. Next Frame loads asynchronously for much faster cook times.

parameters.name: Transform
parameters.description: None: no transform. Static Local/World: apply static transforms. Dynamic: apply animated transforms.

parameters.name: Interpolation
parameters.description: Linear interpolates between keyframes. New in 2025.3: Now interpolates ALL point positions.

troubleshooting.solution: Check Object Path parameter — ensure correct geometry is selected from the dropdown.
Ensure Play Mode is not Locked to Timeline. Press Start button or set to Sequential/Specify Index.
Use Load Type = Next Frame (Fast) for async loading. Reduce geometry complexity if needed.
If same attribute name exists on vertex and point, Alembic In auto-converts to vertex attribute.

description: Loads and plays back Alembic (.abc) file geometry and multi-frame sequences. Supports polymesh (triangles/quads), curves, points, and Alembic transformations. New in 2025.3: Delayed load type, extended playback controls, linear interpolation for all point positions.
